body.text: Operated within the [World Trade Center Istanbul (IDTM)](https://idtm.com.tr/en/istanbul-expo-center/our-expo-center) campus beside the former Atatürk Airport grounds, [Istanbul Expo Center (IFM)](https://ifm.com.tr/en/about-us/about-ifm) hosts major international trade shows across manufacturing, textiles, defence, optics, and food—alongside the neighbouring Yeşilköy fairground formerly known as CNR Expo. How easy is the M1A metro and Marmaray access to IFM Yeşilköy?

Rail access to IFM Yeşilköy is straightforward and reliable. The [M1A Yenikapı–Atatürk Havalimanı metro line](https://istambulmetro.com/en/m1a-line/) stops directly at DTM–İstanbul Fuar Merkezi station, steps from the main exhibition halls. From the Asian side or historic peninsula, take [TCDD Marmaray](https://www.tcddtasimacilik.gov.tr/marmaray) to Yenikapı and transfer straight onto M1A—bypassing E-5 highway traffic entirely.

During major exhibitions, weekday road congestion around the Yeşilköy cloverleaf and Basın Ekspres junctions routinely adds 20 to 30 minutes to short taxi rides. Riding M1A from Yenikapı takes roughly 25 minutes, and transferring at Ataköy–Şirinevler also connects you quickly to the Metrobus corridor. For Asian-side delegates staying in Kadıköy or Bostancı, checking [Marmaray daily train timetables](https://www.tcddtasimacilik.gov.tr/marmaray/tr/gunluk_tren_saatleri) and connecting at Yenikapı is far more predictable than crossing the Eurasia Tunnel at 08:30.

body.text: Which Bakırköy, Ataköy and Yeşilköy hotels put you 10 minutes from the halls?

Hotels along the Ataköy Marina shoreline, Yeşilköy's coastal avenues, and Bakırköy's Sahil Yolu put you within 5 to 12 minutes of the IFM entrances by car—or one to two stops away on the M1A metro. Properties immediately adjacent to the IDTM complex even allow a short walk to morning stand setup.
Use this practical hotel-selection checklist when choosing your IFM base:

items: Immediate campus stays (Yeşilköy / IDTM): Ideal for exhibition managers and technical teams who need 08:00 hall access and midday returns to change or store samples.
Ataköy Marina & Bakırköy waterfront: Strong 5-star business hotels overlooking the Marmara Sea with quiet rooms, executive lounges, and 10-minute taxi or private-driver runs to IFM.
Yeşilköy residential strip: Boutique stays near the Marmaray Yeşilköy station and seaside cafés—calmer in the evenings than highway-side hotels along Basın Ekspres.
Avoid Basın Ekspres without a buffer: Highway-corridor hotels look close on a map, but morning bottlenecks on Basın Ekspres can stretch a 7-kilometre hop into 30 minutes.
Book on-site meeting rooms early: If you need private buyer negotiations away from a noisy booth, reserve [IFM Divan meeting rooms](https://ifm.com.tr/en/ifm-divan-meeting-rooms) ahead of show week.

body.text: How far is IFM from IST airport?

Istanbul Expo Center is roughly 42 to 48 kilometres south of [Istanbul Airport (IST)](https://www.istairport.com/en/airport/airport-transportation?locale=en). By private car via the Northern Marmara Motorway and O-7/Basın Ekspres corridor, plan on 40 to 55 minutes off-peak and 60 to 75 minutes during weekday rush hours or heavy rain.

For solo travelers using public transit from IST, [Havaist airport shuttles](https://www.hava.ist/sefer-saatleri.php?lang=en) serve Bakırköy İDO Pier and Yenibosna/Kuleli corridors, from which a short taxi or M1A metro hop reaches Yeşilköy. Keep in mind that IST terminal walks from check-in to international gates can take 20 to 30 minutes—so leave IFM at least 4 hours before an international departure during afternoon rush hour.
Where are the best Bosphorus or Florya business dinner venues?

For stress-free corporate dinners right after the halls close at 18:00, Florya and Ataköy Marina offer established seafood, ocakbaşı, and modern Turkish restaurants just 10 to 15 minutes from IFM. If you want a Bosphorus waterfront dinner in Karaköy, Beşiktaş, or Arnavutköy, book for 20:00 or later to allow realistic coastal-road transit.

Florya's Marmara-facing restaurants and the marina promenades in Ataköy and Yeşilköy handle international business groups smoothly, with private dining rooms and valet parking. Reserve tables at least a week ahead during flagship IFM exhibitions, when thousands of buyers finish on the floor simultaneously.

faq.q: Which metro station serves Istanbul Expo Center (IFM)?
faq.a: DTM–İstanbul Fuar Merkezi station on the M1A (Yenikapı–Atatürk Havalimanı) metro line drops you directly outside the World Trade Center Istanbul and IFM exhibition halls.

faq.q: Are IFM and CNR Expo in the same area?
faq.a: Yes. Both sit within the Yeşilköy exhibition district beside the former Atatürk Airport site in Bakırköy, though individual hall entrances and event calendars are managed separately.

faq.q: How early should I leave IFM for an international flight at IST?
faq.a: During weekday evening rush hour (16:30–19:30), depart IFM at least 4 hours before your international flight to cover up to 75 minutes of road traffic plus IST security and gate walks.

faq.q: Is it better to stay in Taksim or Bakırköy for an IFM trade show?
faq.a: Stay in Bakırköy, Ataköy, or Yeşilköy if you attend all day for three or more days; stay in Taksim or Sultanahmet only if you prioritize evening central-city sightseeing and plan to commute via M1A metro.

faq.q: Does the M11 airport metro go straight to IFM?
faq.a: No direct M11 station sits at IFM; M11 connects Istanbul Airport toward Gayrettepe and Halkalı. For direct door-to-door speed from IST to Yeşilköy, a pre-booked private transfer or Havaist shuttle to Bakırköy is simpler.
